name: SalesTarget.ai
summary: All-in-one B2B outbound platform: a lead database of 840M+ professional profiles with credit-based enrichment, cold email with unlimited inboxes and warm-up, LinkedIn automation, and a built-in CRM and dialer, sold as separate modules or one bundle per team.
best_for: small sales teams and agencies that want a B2B lead database, cold email with unlimited inboxes and warm-up, LinkedIn automation and a basic CRM under one login, priced per organisation with 3 seats included rather than per seat
skip_if: you need independent proof of data quality before you buy, because we found no third-party reviews we could read; or your plan is AI-personalised email at volume, because SalesTarget's own AI costs 5 email credits per email; or you need LinkedIn volume from day one, because a standard account takes 42 days of warm-up to reach 20 connection requests a day
honest_knock:
The credit numbers on the plan cards shrink once you read the price list. Unlocking an email address costs 2 credits and a phone number 5, and the help centre charges another credit for adding a lead to a list. Growth's 2,000 credits are therefore about 660 leads a month with a verified email, or about 250 if you also want the phone number. AI-written emails and Copilot draw on a separate pool of AI credits: 100 a month on the $30 and $169 Growth plans, with more at $10 per 400.

The 'Super Saver' badge on the bundle is hard to check. Lead Explorer Launch ($49, 2,000 credits) plus Email Outreach Growth ($30, 10,000 emails) comes to $79 for the same allowances as the $169 All In One Growth plan. The $90 difference buys one LinkedIn account and the CRM, and the LinkedIn tab showed no stand-alone price when we read it, so we cannot tell you whether the bundle actually saves money. The Growth plans now include 1 user; a second costs $20 a month only from Scale up.

Two documents disagree on how to leave. The pricing FAQ says you can cancel any time from the dashboard with no cancellation fee, while the terms say subscriptions auto-renew unless 30 days' notice is given and that partial terms are not refunded. Cancel well before the renewal date and keep a record. The 'Limited Time Only' domain-credit banner across the top of the pricing page is a small thing, but it replaced an earlier 'Labor Day Sale' banner that was still up on 1 October. The LinkedIn side is cautious by design: the help centre starts a standard LinkedIn account at 3 connection requests a day, takes 42 days to reach 20 a day, caps it at 100 a week, and halves your daily limit if fewer than 30% of requests are accepted. We found no independent reviews we could read: there is no Product Hunt listing, and G2 and Trustpilot blocked our reader. We have not used the product.

pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-10-28 on salestarget.ai/pricing, tab by tab, monthly billing; the vendor told us on 28 October that its plans had changed) Sold either as one bundle or module by module. All In One, the default tab with a 'Super Saver' badge: Growth $169 a month (10,000 emails, 2,000 Lead Explorer credits, 1 LinkedIn account, 100 AI credits, 1 user, warm-up for 5 email accounts), Scale $319 (100,000 emails, 4,500 credits, 2 LinkedIn accounts, 500 AI credits, 3 users, warm-up for 20 accounts), Ultimate $639 (500,000 emails, 7,000 credits, 3 LinkedIn accounts, 1,000 AI credits, 5 users, warm-up for 50 accounts, 3 client workspaces and a one-time $300 wallet credit), Enterprise on request. Lead Explorer on its own: Launch Credit $49 for 2,000 credits a month (1 user), Builder Credit $99 for 4,500 (3 users), Expansion Credit $149 for 7,000 (5 users). Email Outreach on its own: Growth $30 for 10,000 emails a month (1 user, 30,000 contacts stored), Hypergrowth $79 for 100,000 (3 users), Light Speed $299 for 500,000 (5 users) with a one-time $200 wallet credit; new customers get 30% off the first month on any monthly Email Outreach plan. CRM $40 a month with 3 users included and $20 per extra user; Dialer $29 a month with one number and 400 credits, extra numbers $3 local or $5 toll-free. Add-ons on the plans: extra LinkedIn accounts $49 each a month, extra warm-up slots $2 per email account, client workspaces $29, extra AI credits $10 per 400, extra users $20. A 'Customize Yourself' builder prices each part with sliders. The yearly toggle says 'Save 10%' on All In One and 'Save 15%' on Email Outreach; we did not re-read the yearly prices on 28 October. The wallet credits can only be spent on domains bought inside SalesTarget, not on email accounts, and are non-refundable. Free trial: the pricing FAQ says 50 Lead Explorer credits and no credit card. A banner reading 'Subscribe Today & Get $200 or $300 Domain Credit, Limited Time Only!' runs across the top of the page. Payment is by credit card. Salestarget LLC, with an address in Wilmington, Delaware.

compare_with.name: Apollo
compare_with.why: Apollo is the obvious alternative: like SalesTarget it puts a B2B contact database, enrichment and email sequences in one product. The difference is how you pay. Apollo charges per seat: on our reading of 11 September 2026 it had a free plan with 900 credits per seat per year, and paid plans of $49, $79 and $119 per seat a month on annual billing, or $65, $99 and $149 month to month, with Organization requiring three seats. SalesTarget, read on 1 October 2026, charges per organisation with 3 seats included: All In One Growth at $169 a month covers the whole team, where three Apollo Professional seats paid monthly come to $297. That makes SalesTarget cheaper on paper for a small team. Apollo has the free plan, which SalesTarget does not, and a large base of users and reviews you can check before you buy, which we could not find for SalesTarget. Pick Apollo if you want the established option and are one or two people; consider SalesTarget if you are a team of three that also wants LinkedIn automation and a dialer in the same bill.
